context: A boss reviews a new product launch comms plan
purpose: Teach: 修士/勧誘/創刊/劣化/書士/ウェブログ/意味合い/度合い

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新商品のローンチ計画書、ざっと目を通したよ。意味合いは伝わるが、戦略の深さが足りないな。
lines.en: I skimmed the new product launch plan. The intent comes across, but the strategic depth is lacking.
lines.style: Boss speaks firmly with measured authority and pointed critique.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 申し訳ありません。店頭での勧誘キャンペーンの数値を反映し損ねまして、急ぎ差し替えます。
lines.en: I'm sorry. I failed to reflect the numbers from the in-store promotional campaign; I'll swap them in right away.
lines.style: Subordinate replies apologetically with a formal humble tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 頼む。それから、提携誌の創刊号に広告を出す件、扱いの度合いをはっきりさせてくれ。
lines.en: Please do. And about placing an ad in the partner magazine's inaugural issue—make the prominence clear.
lines.style: Boss continues with concrete corrective direction and follow-up.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。あわせて、競合品の品質劣化を比較データで示す欄を追加してもよろしいですか。
lines.en: Understood. May I also add a section showing competitors' quality degradation with comparison data?
lines.style: Office worker responds attentively while proposing an additional angle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 載せろ。商標登録の手続きは司法書士の先生に直接回しておけ。法務部の確認は私が通す。
lines.en: Include it. Route the trademark registration paperwork directly to our judicial scrivener. I'll push the legal department's check through.
lines.style: Boss delivers concise instructions with a clear command tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。それと、古い社内資料に「個人ウェブログでの告知案」という記述が残っていますが、削除でよろしいでしょうか。
lines.en: Yes. Also, an old internal document still has a note saying 'announcement plan via personal weblogs'—shall I delete it?
lines.style: Subordinate raises a minor cleanup question diplomatically and carefully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 消しておけ。公式チャネル優先で、私的発信の度合いは事前にすり合わせる方針だ。
lines.en: Delete it. Official channels come first, and the extent of personal posting is to be coordinated in advance.
lines.style: Boss firmly redirects with clear prioritization and policy framing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。最後に、修士号を持つ食品研究者にインタビューを依頼する案はいかがでしょう。
lines.en: Understood. Finally, what about requesting an interview with a food researcher who holds a master's degree?
lines.style: Subordinate offers a final professional suggestion with measured confidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 悪くない。説得力が増す。明日の朝までに修正版を出してくれ。
lines.en: Not bad. It adds credibility. Submit the revised version by tomorrow morning.
lines.style: Boss closes the meeting with a decisive approving tone.
